policy.rationale: Requested openclaw plugin and skill installs are cataloged as metadata-only entries. Open-Connect never downloads, executes, or auto-installs registry packages; each entry requires license verification and a separate security review before it can become installable.

resolution.openclaw_registry_package_name: Unqualified package name (@latest) has no verified publisher URL; resolve from the OpenClaw registry at review time.
resolution.github_repository: @file:owner/repo resolves to the upstream GitHub repository.
resolution.clawhub_publisher: clawhub.ai/<owner> publisher page; package name and kind must be resolved from the publisher catalog at review time.
